popups.title: Enemy Arsenal
popups.text: This is your opponent's arsenal. Their relics, deck count, and identity appear here. Study it before committing your forces.

popups.title: Your Hand
popups.text: These are the cards in your hand. Each costs attunement (the number at the top) to play. Drag a card onto the board to summon it.

popups.title: Card Anatomy
popups.text: The cost disc (top-left) shows attunement needed. The red number is Attack; the green is Vigor (health). A creature with 0 attack cannot deal damage.

popups.title: Attunement
popups.text: Your attunement is your mana pool. Each card costs attunement to play. Attunement refills each turn, and can be increased by excavating.

popups.title: The Board
popups.text: These are your lanes — the battlefield. Drag a creature card from your hand onto an empty lane to summon it. Each lane holds one creature per side.

popups.title: Ritual Cards
popups.text: This card has a Ritual effect — a one-time ability that triggers when played. Your artifacts also have active abilities; watch for their triggers.

popups.title: Your Relics
popups.text: Your relics — the Aura and the Wand — sit here. Each grants a passive bonus. The Aura gives +1 Vigor to your creatures; the Wand opens spell options.

popups.title: Enemy Hand
popups.text: The enemy also holds cards. You can see how many by counting the card backs here. Plan your attacks around what they might play.

popups.title: Your Deck & Barrow
popups.text: Your deck contains cards you haven't drawn yet. The Barrow holds cards that have been Buried — removed from your deck by effects or overdraw.

popups.title: End Turn
popups.text: When you have no more actions to take, press End Turn to pass to your opponent. Your attunement will refill at the start of your next turn.

popups.title: Attack!
popups.text: Tap one of your creatures, then tap an enemy creature or lane to attack. Your Aura gives +1 Vigor while they stand, making them harder to remove.

popups.title: Keywords
popups.text: Some cards have keywords like GUARD or SWIFT. GUARD creatures protect adjacent allies. SWIFT creatures can attack the turn they are summoned.

popups.title: Victory
popups.text: You have learned the basics. Keep practicing — each class plays differently. The Drowned Archive is just the beginning of your journey.
